meta.title: Privacy Policy — Little Fortuna · InkWild Games
meta.description: How Little Fortuna handles your information: what stays on your phone, what the ads collect, and the choices you have.

title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Little Fortuna: Thief & Tumble

summary.title: The short version
summary.text: Little Fortuna has no accounts, no sign-in, and no play statistics: your progress stays on your phone. The game contains ads from Google AdMob, which collect information to show and measure them, and it offers one optional one-time purchase that removes every ad.

intro: This policy explains what information Little Fortuna: Thief & Tumble (the "game") handles, why, and what choices you have. "We" means InkWild Games, the independent studio that makes the game.

collect.title: What the game handles
collect.intro: Little Fortuna asks for no email address, real name, or password, and it sends us nothing about how you play. This is everything it handles:

device.label: Kept on your device only.
device.text: Your gold, best distance, and number of finished runs; your upgrades, Thief Rank, guild jobs, and daily heist calendar; your tools, outfits, and treasures; the hazards you have already met; a record of your best run, so you can race it again; which how-to tips you have seen; your music, effects, vibration, Calm mode, and language settings; when you last saw an ad, so ads stay spaced out; and whether you own Remove Ads, so the game works offline. None of this is sent to us. Uninstalling the game deletes it.

ads.label: Advertising data.
ads.text: Google AdMob, the ad software in the game, and Google's ad partners may collect the data described under Advertising below.

purchase.label: Purchase status.
purchase.text: Whether you own Remove Ads, which the game checks with Google Play or the Apple App Store each time it starts. Payment itself is handled by the store.

updates.label: Updates (Android).
updates.text: When the game starts, and when you return to it, it asks Google Play whether a newer version is available; if there is one, you are asked to update before playing. To answer, Google Play uses your device details and the installed version of the game, under Google Play's own terms. The game only learns whether an update is available.

engine.label: Device statistics.
engine.text: When the game starts, the Unity engine it is built with may send Unity Technologies technical details about your device, such as its model, operating system, graphics hardware, and screen, to help Unity improve the engine. They contain no name or contact details and nothing about how you play. Unity handles them under its own privacy policy.

nocollect.title: What it does not collect
nocollect.text: The game has no accounts, no player ID of its own, no cloud saves, no leaderboards, and no play statistics or error reports. It does not collect your real name, email address, phone number, contacts, precise location, photos, or microphone or camera data. It never sees your payment card details; purchases are handled by Google Play or the Apple App Store.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.intro: Little Fortuna contains ads. The ad provider is Google AdMob (the Google Mobile Ads SDK), and ads are served by Google and its ad partners. There are two kinds of ads: full-screen (interstitial) ads between runs, and optional rewarded ads. There are no banner ads.

when.label: When ads appear.
when.text: Full-screen ads appear only after a run has ended, when you leave the result screen to run again or to go back to the menu. You see none in your first 10 finished runs; after that, at most one every 3 to 5 finished runs, and never within 30 seconds of another ad. Nothing is shown while you run, at start-up, in menus, or in Settings.

rewarded.label: Optional rewarded ads.
rewarded.text: You may choose to watch a short ad for an in-game benefit: Vanish, a second chance when the City Watch corners you (once per run), or doubling the gold from a run. Watching is never required, and players who buy Remove Ads get these benefits without an ad.

data.intro: To show and measure ads, Google AdMob (the Google Mobile Ads SDK) in the game and Google's ad partners may collect:
data.li1: the advertising identifier of your device (on iPhone, only if you allow tracking);
data.li2: an approximate location derived from your IP address;
data.li3: device and app information, such as device model, operating system, app version, and language;
data.li5: diagnostics, such as crashes and performance.
data.share: Google and its ad partners may receive this information and handle it under their own privacy policies.

choices.label: Your choices.
choices.text: In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, a consent form provided by Google asks for your choice, and the Ad privacy button in Settings lets you change it at any time. On iPhone, the system asks whether the game may track you before any ads are shown. On any phone you can also reset or limit the advertising identifier in your phone's settings.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.intro: Little Fortuna is free to play. Gold is earned only by playing and is never sold. The game offers one optional, one-time purchase: Remove Ads.
purchases.pay: You pay through Google Play or the Apple App Store, which handle your payment. The game never sees your card details.
purchases.effect: Remove Ads turns off every ad permanently, and you get Vanish and the doubled gold without watching an ad. It changes nothing else in the game.
purchases.restore: We have no account system of our own. If you get a new phone, the purchase is restored from the store; you can also tap Restore purchases in Settings. The game keeps a copy on your phone so it works offline.

use.title: How we use information
use.li1: To run the game and keep your progress on your phone.
use.li2: To show ads, and to turn them off if you buy Remove Ads.
use.li3: To check with the store whether you own Remove Ads.
use.li4: On Android, to check whether a required update is available.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.li1: Ads: change your consent with the Ad privacy button in Settings (where a consent form is shown), or reset or limit the advertising identifier in your phone's settings. On iPhone you can change whether the game may track you in the phone's Settings. Buying Remove Ads turns every ad off.
choices.li2: Offline play: the game works without a connection. Ads, the purchase, and the update check need one.
choices.li3: Deleting data: uninstalling the game deletes everything it saved on your phone. We keep none of your game data on our own servers, so there is nothing else for us to delete; Google and the stores keep their own records under their own policies. You can still contact us with any question.

providers.title: Who processes your information
providers.text: We use Google AdMob (Google) to show ads, and Google Play or the Apple App Store for the Remove Ads purchase and, on Android, the update check. They process information under their own terms, and they may process it in countries other than yours, including the United States. We do not sell your name or contact details (we do not have them). The advertising data described under Advertising may be received by Google and its ad partners, which some laws describe as sharing information for advertising; you can limit this with the choices described there.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: The game keeps your progress on your phone until you uninstall it. We keep nothing about you on our own servers. Google and its ad partners keep advertising data, and the stores keep your purchase record, under their own policies.

children.title: Children
children.text: Little Fortuna is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 where local law sets a higher age). We do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Depending on where you live (for example the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Mexico, or California), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, to object to its use, and to withdraw consent at any time. You can change your advertising consent with the Ad privacy button, and contact us to exercise any other right.

security.title: Security
security.text: The game sends only what is described here, and ads and purchases go through Google's and the stores' secured services. No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: If the game changes in a way that affects your privacy (for example by adding sign-in, cloud saves, achievements, or play statistics), we will update this policy before that version reaches you. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.
